benchmark: PCOE Product Passport and Asset Lifecycle Qualification

scenarios.preconditions: Two physical assets or suppliers present the same serial, batch or passport identifier.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Reuse a registry product identifier on a different installed asset.
scenarios.required_control: Bind passport and product identifiers to the actual manufacturer, product instance/batch and registry; detect duplicate identities.

scenarios.preconditions: A service provider attempts to create/update a passport without valid written authorization.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Remove the written authorization, narrow its scope, or expire it before the update.
scenarios.required_control: Validate the responsible economic operator's mandate, delegate identity, scope, validity and revocation.

scenarios.threat: Pending passport registration promoted to current
scenarios.preconditions: A local system caches a passport submission but the registry has not confirmed registration.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Use a pending, rejected or unavailable registry response as registered/current.
scenarios.required_control: Only an authenticated registry status/receipt under the applicable profile can establish registration.

scenarios.preconditions: An unauthorized agent, buyer or public transparency service requests restricted battery or facility information.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to disclose a restricted data point beyond the caller's purpose and authority.
scenarios.required_control: Enforce product-data access rights, purpose limitation and selective disclosure.

scenarios.preconditions: The installed component differs from the product/component identity covered by procurement and conformity evidence.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replace an inverter, cell module or critical controller without updating the evidence graph.
scenarios.required_control: Bind installed serial/configuration to accepted product and conformity evidence; require applicable reassessment.

scenarios.preconditions: A maintenance work order is treated as proof of successful repair or restored safety.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Omit post-repair test/inspection evidence while marking the asset serviceable.
scenarios.required_control: Keep service record, repair disposition and qualified safety inspection as separate evidence types.

scenarios.preconditions: A used battery is repurposed/remanufactured and a new passport is created without linking the prior passport.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Create a new product/passport identity without the required predecessor reference.
scenarios.required_control: Create the legally required linked new passport and preserve the predecessor's provenance.

scenarios.preconditions: An issuer/authority publishes a safety recall or suspension but local asset projections remain active.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replay a cached passport after a relevant recall, suspension or safety notice.
scenarios.required_control: Propagate authoritative recall/suspension events and block consequential acceptance until resolved.

scenarios.preconditions: The registry is unavailable or the local cache is older than the allowed freshness window.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Use old data as proof of current registration, ownership or compliance.
scenarios.required_control: Declare freshness, last verified checkpoint and offline policy; stale status cannot become current.

scenarios.preconditions: A correction or invalidated product claim overwrites prior records and breaks auditability.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Delete or mutate predecessor statement rather than append a correction/supersession.
scenarios.required_control: Use append-only correction and supersession links; reevaluate dependent obligations.

scenarios.preconditions: Material composition or recycled-content claim lacks a traceable issuer/evidence chain.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Promote an unsupported supplier declaration to independently verified claim.
scenarios.required_control: Bind exact data points to supplier evidence, applicable verification method and issuer/assessor scope.

scenarios.threat: Passport does not bind to financed/installed asset
scenarios.preconditions: A procurement, warranty or maintenance obligation references a model/SKU instead of the exact installed product identity.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Substitute a different product instance while retaining the old contract/commissioning evidence.
scenarios.required_control: Bind contract, delivery, commissioning, warranty and service events to a stable product/asset identity.
